name: 实现 EnvironmentService (part 1)
description:
实现 EnvironmentService 服务方法: create_environment, get_environment, list_environments
  - create_environment: (request: EnvironmentCreateRequest, actor: String) -> Environment pre=EnvironmentCreateRequest 所有必填字段已通过格式校验；key_id 必须对应 ssh_keys 
  - get_environment: (environment_id: UUID) -> Environment pre=environment_id 不能为空
  - list_environments: () -> List[Environment] pre=无
